title: What to know about the new health check for 3yo kids
byline: Nas Campanella; Evan Young; Rhiannon Hobbins
paragraphs: What to know about the new Medicare developmental check for three-year-olds
From today, hundreds of thousands of three-year-olds across the country will have access to a new Medicare-subsidised developmental screening program.

The initiative, part of the Thriving Kids program aimed at picking up some of the children to be diverted from the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), is intended to give families cheaper access to a doctor to help catch developmental concerns early.
